questions.markdown: An AC voltage of peak value $20\,\text{V}$ is connected in series with a silicon diode and load resistance of $500\,\Omega$. If the forward resistance of the diode is $10\,\Omega$, find (i) peak current through the diode and (ii) peak output voltage. What will be these values if the diode is assumed to be ideal?
Describe Zener breakdown and Avalanche breakdown. Under what conditions does each mechanism occur, and how do they differ in terms of operation and physical processes?
With the help of circuit diagrams, explain the working of a full-wave bridge rectifier with a capacitive filter.

A 12V Zener regulator has a minimum and maximum Zener current requirements of $1\,\text{mA}$ and $32\,\text{mA}$ respectively. If the input voltage is $50\,\text{V}$ and the series resistance is $1\,\text{k}\Omega$, determine the minimum and maximum load resistances and the corresponding load currents

Design a circuit using two Op-Amps to produce the following output voltage:

$$
V_{out} = 10V_1 - 5V_2 + 0.5V_3 - V_4,
$$

where $V_1$, $V_2$, $V_3$ and $V_4$ are input voltages. Assume $R_F = 10\,\text{k}\Omega$ and draw the circuit.

questions.markdown: An Op-Amp comparator is connected with $10\sin(2000\pi t)$ to the inverting input terminal and $-3\,\text{V}$ to the non-inverting input terminal. Draw the circuit and sketch the input-output waveforms, assuming $\pm 12\,\text{V}$ supply voltages.
Represent the decimal number $(210.98)_{10}$ in (a) Hexadecimal, (b) Binary, (c) 8 4 2 1 BCD, (d) 2 4 2 1 BC

Simplify the following Boolean expression using the K map and implement using only NAND gates.

$$
F(A, B, C, D) = \Sigma m(0, 2, 3, 7, 14) + \Sigma d(4, 6, 9, 13)
$$
Design a 4:1 MUX and implement it using basic gates.
Draw the logic diagram of a 3-bit asynchronous up counter using positive edge-triggered JK flip flops. Also, plot the timing diagram
Derive the time domain expression of the AM wave and sketch its spectrum. Also, find the percentage of carrier power transmitted under perfect modulation.

Define Frequency modulation. Given an FM Wave, $S_{FM}(t) = 18\cos[2\pi\,10^7 t + 7\sin(2\pi\,30000 t)]$.

Calculate (i). Carrier frequency (ii). Modulating frequency (iii). Frequency deviation, and (iv). Bandwidth using Carson's rule.
